# ProMan Painting & Wallpaper

> Painting and wallpaper contractor based in Lyman, South Carolina, serving Greenville,
> Spartanburg and the surrounding Upstate. Specialises in wallpaper installation and removal,
> including murals, designer papers and papered ceilings — a service most painting companies
> in the region do not offer.

- Owner: Roman Ponomarenko
- Phone: (864) 000-0000
- Email: info@promanpainting.com
- Base: Lyman, SC 29365
- Hours: Open 24 hours
- Ratings: 5.0 on Google (28 reviews), 4.9 on Thumbtack (83 reviews)

## Services
- [Wallpaper Installation](https://promanpainting.com/wallpaper-installation/): Professional wallpaper installation across Greenville, Spartanburg and the Upstate. Murals, designer paper, grasscloth and peel-and-stick. Free estimates.
- [Wallpaper Removal](https://promanpainting.com/wallpaper-removal/): Old wallpaper removed without wrecking the drywall, walls repaired and left ready to paint or re-paper. Serving Greenville, Spartanburg and the Upstate.
- [Interior Painting](https://promanpainting.com/interior-painting/): Interior house painting across Greenville, Spartanburg and the Upstate — walls, ceilings, trim, doors and accent walls. Free estimates.
- [Trim & Molding](https://promanpainting.com/trim-and-molding/): Trim, crown molding, baseboards and board-and-batten installed and finished. Serving Greenville, Spartanburg and the Upstate. Free estimates.
- [Commercial Painting](https://promanpainting.com/commercial-painting/): Commercial painting and wallcovering for offices, retail and small commercial spaces across Greenville, Spartanburg and the Upstate. Free estimates.
- [Cabinet Painting](https://promanpainting.com/cabinet-painting/): Kitchen and bathroom cabinet painting across Greenville, Spartanburg and the Upstate — degreased, sanded, primed and finished properly. Free estimates.
- [Exterior Painting](https://promanpainting.com/exterior-painting/): Exterior house painting for Greenville, Spartanburg and the Upstate — siding, trim, soffits, shutters and doors. Free estimates.
- [Deck & Fence](https://promanpainting.com/deck-and-fence-painting/): Deck and fence staining, sealing and painting across Greenville, Spartanburg and the Upstate. Free estimates.

## Service area
Greenville SC, Spartanburg SC, Greer SC, Simpsonville SC, Five Forks SC, Taylors SC, Mauldin SC, Duncan SC, Lyman SC, Boiling Springs SC, Travelers Rest SC, Inman SC
